active/unknown execution retains reservation and is nonterminal
failure with blocked descendants is terminal but not accepted

consumer_limit: The small consumer fixture checks state/count consistency but is not a receipt-signature or provenance verifier. A fully self-consistent forged success object is accepted; callers must supply a trusted dispatcher snapshot, not arbitrary JSON.
remaining_lifecycle_limits: No power-loss/fsync fault, large-DAG closure scale, thousands-cycle, service-intake seal or durable restore claim.
Completion is a current-admissions snapshot; work can reopen when new admission arrives.
Mutable SQLite/cooperating-writer trust and source/history limitations persist from the predecessor.
